archiveAndConfig.assertionPolicy: All original archive evidence/schema/provenance/reviewer/path/bounds/cross-binding and pure config assertions remain unchanged and execute current. Store inspector changes only its bounded current-source proof import/call dispatch; all other statements remain exact original.

hostLimits: Two original file-symlink cases are unavailable on this Windows host and stay attributed as original host skips. Linux must execute them. Actual junction/hardlink/ancestor/race controls are separately executable on Windows.

predecessor.qualification: Immutable accepted C46 coverage definitions only. Every executable/current-source assertion must execute on actual C47 source; a predecessor receipt is never substituted.

current47ExecutionPolicy.sourceScope: Actual clean currently checked-out C47 HEAD, tree and committed bytes; complete original current46 input/configuration/installed-native proof is required before generated-only transition. A test-merge checkout must truthfully bind its source head and tree.
current47ExecutionPolicy.perRowPolicy: Remove only each added current47 field and require exact structural equality to the authenticated immutable C46 row. No original name, program, invocation, test, assertion, historical-control qualification or execution category is changed. Execute each distinct required command once on the measured C47 source and resolve every row to its actual named test result; never execute the gate90times or add the90obligation denominator to actual test counts.
current47ExecutionPolicy.descriptorHashQualification: Descriptor path is bound by source/consumer/external seal; map deliberately does not hash the descriptor, avoiding a map-descriptor self-hash cycle.
current47ExecutionPolicy.generatedBuildWorkspaceQualification: The original90/source gate executes on unprojected current source. Any already-declared isolated build scripts-only projection occurs after that fresh source proof, is separately preimage/postimage-bound, and never substitutes for it.

generated47Controls.invariant: Actual current C47 source and complete native proof
requiredAssertions: SOURCE executes runNativeCurrent46(root) against actual current checkout, not an accepted-parent checkout.
All original verified source/configuration/installed-native inputs and complete native denominators remain required.
SOURCE receipt binds actual HEAD/tree/committed input bytes and all new47 helper/consumer/test/mapping pins; no earlier source proof is relabeled.
Only generated ios/Podfile.properties.json apple.extraPods is changed.

The exact ordered entries are GoogleUtilities/Environment and RecaptchaInterop, each with modular_headers=true and no other keys/options. GoogleUtilities root/default subspec expansion is not authorized.

The apple.extraPods key must be absent before the repair; every other generated properties entry remains semantically and evidentially unchanged. The property is the exact supported string-encoded JSON tuple list; missing/conflicting/extra tuples or unsupported field types refuse.
No global use_modular_headers!, use_frameworks!, permission/module removal or runtime behavior change substitutes for the exact transition.
Actual generated Podfile preimage and postimage are byte-identical.
Installed official Expo extraPods consumer executes the unchanged generated Podfile hook; no handwritten Podfile replacement or app.config edit.
Normal npm install/hooks and installed native/source security patches remain mandatory.

generated47Controls.invariant: Authenticated current installed consumer and immutable inputs
requiredAssertions: Descriptor binds exact lock/package identities, canonical registry resolution/SRI and installed consumer source hashes.
Consumer/helper/test/mapping committed bytes are independently read and pinned before transition.
Only exact current generated-input compatibility is authorized; no dependency/native-source or original46 descriptor/test mutation is admitted.

Wrong root/source/helper pin, stale or forged receipt, linked/hardlinked input, duplicate JSON keys, malformed/unsupported/conflicting properties and undeclared pod options refuse before success evidence.
Bounded safe reads, exact preimage/postimage identities and atomic mutation/readback protect the finite generated target.
A refused operation does not become a successful transition or qualify stale output.

generated47Controls.invariant: Generated receipt is consumed by actual native build
requiredAssertions: GENERATED phase authenticates the actual helper receipt and actual generated properties/unchanged Podfile.
The same bound generated workspace is passed to pod install and xcodebuild; actual Podfile.lock/configuration/build logs are retained.
Source-only/helper controls never stand in for successful CocoaPods install, Mach-O linking, installation or UI execution.

generated47Controls.invariant: Original90 plus archive/config coverage remains complete
requiredAssertions: Exactly90 unique original rows remain with every original assertion and the exact current46 equivalent preserved.
Original program bytes and accepted46 mapping/descriptor remain authenticated and unchanged.
Original archive/schema/provenance/reviewer/path/bounds/cross-binding/configuration programs execute current source, with host skips explicit.
Generated47 controls are additive and counted separately from the original90 obligation denominator.

generated47Controls.invariant: No independent admission or production activation
requiredAssertions: All security, DB custody, M1-03, M2, J01, paid, native, Apple and public-release admissions remain false.
Source-only/native-compatibility reports cannot claim archive inspection, signature verification, physical-device qualification or App Store acceptance.
The helper is scoped to the isolated unsigned Simulator build coordinator; no normal production configuration is mutated.

claimQualification: Required validation mapping only; not an execution receipt. Actual unsigned Simulator build/install/launch remains NOT_RUN until its exact-source artifact and raw receipts exist. Independent native/owner/release admission remains false even after scoped Simulator execution.
